note: Literature links dHMN11 to heterozygous nonsense / loss-of-function variants in SPTAN1, distinguishing it from dominant-negative mutations causing severe encephalopathy.

evidence.text: Heterozygous nonsense mutations in SPTAN1 were identified in the pathogenesis of hereditary motor neuropathies.

source.title: Hereditary motor neuropathies
source.quote: identified heterozygous nonsense mutations in SPTAN1, a gene previously described in the context of epilepsy syndromes.

evidence.text: SPTAN1 is associated with autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 11 (HMND11) through nonsense variants.
